ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Sep-16-2003 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/V.Mack, CSR: Kent Gubbine
Petitioner, Margaret Rosanna Whitten present in pro per, was sworn and examined.

The Court grants the petition for change of name to: Margaret Rosanna Aragones Whitten.

Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Sep-02-2003 Reset To Sep-16-03 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: Present: Petitioner: Margaret Whitten; Judge Ollie Marie-Victoire; Clerk: Craig Blackstone; Reporter: Valerie Papale. Petitioner having failed to file proof of publication, the matter is continued to September 16, 2003 at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218. (D. 505)
